title: Tessera Bio Dataset Card v0.4 extension (additive, optional)
description: Additive extension to v0.3. This is NOT a full schema — it documents a single optional field (biofm_compatibility) added in v0.4. A v0.2 or v0.3 card validates unchanged against its own schema. Cards that populate this field declare their BioFM compatibility as metadata; Tessera does not run any BioFM in-platform.

biofm_compatibility.description: Optional. Documents which Bio foundation models (BioFMs) are known to consume this dataset's modality. Tessera asserts the compatibility as metadata — it does not validate by running the model. This field is non-proprietary and extensible: any BioFM framework (Helical, Hugging Face, direct) can be referenced. The downstream consumer (e.g., Helical) is responsible for actually running the model.

name.description: BioFM name and version, e.g., 'Geneformer vLARGE', 'scGPT v1', 'Tahoe-x1', 'ESM-2 t33 650M'.

framework.description: The framework that hosts the model. Currently: 'Helical' (the leading BioFM orchestration framework), 'Hugging Face', 'direct'.

modality_match.description: How closely the dataset's modality matches the BioFM's expected input. 'exact' = direct consumption; 'compatible' = small transformation (e.g., pseudobulk aggregation); 'approximate' = significant transformation (e.g., Ensembl ID → gene symbol conversion).

input_format.description: The expected input format, e.g., 'raw counts per cell (cells × genes)', 'ranked gene expression tokens per cell', 'protein sequences (FASTA)'.

perturbation_support.description: Whether the BioFM supports in-silico perturbation experiments (gene knockdown, over-expression). This is a property of the BioFM, not of the dataset.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the compatibility, e.g., 'requires gene-name conversion from Ensembl IDs to symbols via pinned Ensembl v110'.

fine_tuning_protocol.description: Recommended fine-tuning protocol, including which split to fine-tune on, which to evaluate on, and which pinned references to use.

last_verified_against_release.description: The BioFM framework release against which this compatibility was last verified, e.g., 'helical==0.7.2 (2026-09)'. When the framework releases a new version, this field flags that the compatibility may need re-verification — analogous to the identifier_drift_report for Ensembl releases.

$comment: v0.4 extension. This schema is intentionally minimal — it documents one optional field. v0.2 and v0.3 cards validate unchanged against their own schemas. Tessera cards that populate biofm_compatibility do so as metadata only; Tessera never runs the BioFM. The relationship between Tessera and BioFM frameworks (Helical specifically) is a substrate relationship: Helical consumes Tessera-pinned data; Helical outputs come back into Tessera as a new hash-pinned artefact type (planned for v0.5).
